findings.title: Heat-loss learners absorb solar-model error: UA bias +0.094 to +0.254 per unit aperture error over 6 plants
findings.claim: the heat-loss learners absorb solar-model error.
findings.metric_definition: effective house UA / truth - 1, mean of the last 7 of 42 days.

evidence.value: slope +0.094 to +0.254 per unit aperture error over 6 plants; leave-one-out +0.161 to +0.254
evidence.unit: relative UA error per unit relative aperture error

findings.phenomenon_property: a learner must not fold a residual containing an unmodelled regressor whose mean is not zero
findings.proposed_fix_scope: G-ID-1: heat-loss learners fold night intervals only (coordinator.py, const.py)

findings.title: Open-window detector trips on model bias and freezes every learner: 15-19 % of intervals at delivery 0.4, 0 at 1.0
findings.claim: the open-window detector trips on model bias and freezes every learner, including the ones that would remove the bias.

evidence.value: 15-19 % tripped at delivery 0.4, 0 % at 1.0 (windows closed); owner install figure cited by commit 4f2d513c9

findings.proposed_fix_scope: G-ID-2: ventilation detector distinguishes bias from an open window
